title: Neon Diner Memories
style: synthwave, retro 80s, neon, analog synths, gated reverb drums, nostalgic, late-night cruising, male vocal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Chrome counter glow, the jukebox hums alive
Two coffees cold, the rain blurs the drive
You traced my name in the steam on the glass
Promised forever wouldn't pass

[Pre-Chorus]
The clock kept spinning, neon bleeding through the night
We were younger then, painted in pink and blue light

[Chorus]
Neon diner memories
Burning slow inside of me
Every booth a photograph
Of a love that used to laugh
Neon diner memories
Ghosts in vinyl harmonies

[Verse 2]
The waitress smiled, she'd seen our kind before
Two kids in love by the open back door
Sugar packets, secrets stacked up high
Underneath that sodium sky

[Chorus]
Neon diner memories
Burning slow inside of me
Every booth a photograph
Of a love that used to laugh
Neon diner memories
Ghosts in vinyl harmonies

[Bridge]
If I drove back tonight, would the sign still flicker on?
Would I find you waiting, or just the song we'd put on?

[Outro]
Neon diner memories
Fading into history
